title: Bipe PIN check
summary: The pad that asks a signed-in phone for the Bipe PIN (the senha of pinLength numbers) before an action that needs it, checked by the server (ADR 0283 rules 10 to 14, bipe-chat/bipe#1349, bipe-chat/bipe#1350). Every caller gives one reason line. Every pad has bipe_pin_forgot, which shows only the ways out that the account has.

title.description: The caller's title, for example bipe_email_title.

reason.description: The caller's reason line, one of bipe_pin_reason_* with pinLength. It names the secret as the Bipe PIN of pinLength numbers and says why the app asks now.

phase.description: entering: the pad. checking: the caller's check runs. blocked: the server answered pin_blocked; the pad shows bipe_pin_blocked_body and takes no digits. forgot: the ways-out sheet. resetPin and resetConfirm: the signup-pin steps for the new PIN (bipe_recovery_new_pin_title, then bipe_pin_confirm_title). resetSending: POST /v1/me/pin/reset runs. resetWaiting: bipe_recovery_waiting_title, bipe_recovery_waiting_pin_body with ready_at, and bipe_pin_reset_cancel. resetDone: bipe_recovery_pin_ready and, when the account has no recovery email, bipe_pin_reset_add_email with bipe_fallback_email. resetCancelled: bipe_pin_reset_cancelled. resetExpired: bipe_pin_reset_expired.

error.description: bipe_pin_wrong with tries left, bipe_pin_blocked_body, bipe_error_rate_limited, bipe_error_network or bipe_error_generic.

ways.description: The ways out, from GET /v1/me/account when the forgot sheet opens, and from the phone. phone: this phone has biometrics set up (OwnerCheck), so it can reset the PIN here (ADR 0283 rule 13). email: a verified recovery email. Both can show. none: neither. A linked Apple or Google account never resets the PIN (ADR 0096), so it is not a way out.

type.effect: Adds the digit. At pinLength digits, runs the caller's check (POST /v1/me/pin/check, or the caller's own route that takes the PIN). Pass: closes the pad with success haptic. 403 pin_wrong: bipe_pin_wrong with tries_left. 403 pin_blocked: phase blocked. Other errors as listed in error.

forgot.effect: Opens the forgot sheet, titled bipe_pin_forgot_title. When this phone keeps a waiting reset for this account, the sheet opens in resetWaiting. Else it reads GET /v1/me/account. phone: bipe_pin_forgot_phone with recoveryDelayHours.email and the button bipe_pin_forgot_phone_action. email: bipe_pin_forgot_email with the verified address and recoveryDelayHours.email. none: bipe_pin_forgot_none. The sheet never names a way the account does not have. While the read runs, the sheet shows a spinner; a failed read shows bipe_error_network or bipe_error_generic.

closeForgot.effect: Back to the pad, in the phase it had.

cancel.effect: Closes the pad. The caller treats it as a cancel. Nothing is sent.

resetHere.effect: From forgot with way phone: the biometric owner check with bipe_pin_reset_biometric (never the passcode). A fail or cancel stays on forgot. A pass opens resetPin. The new PIN twice (pinProblem on the phone first), then POST /v1/me/pin/reset with new_pin. 202: the phone keeps RecoveryStarted for this account (keychain or the account's encrypted store, never synced), then resetWaiting. 400 pin_weak: back to resetPin with the problem. 409 pin_reset_pending: bipe_pin_reset_pending. 409 pin_not_set, 429 and others: the error texts.

claim.effect: On sheet open, at ready_at and when the app comes to the foreground: POST /v1/recovery/{recoveryId}/claim with the kept claim secret. waiting: stays. completed: forgets the kept reset, resetDone. cancelled: forgets it, resetCancelled. expired or 403 recovery_invalid: forgets it, resetExpired.

cancelReset.effect: From resetWaiting: POST /v1/me/recoveries/{recoveryId}/cancel, then forgets the kept reset and shows resetCancelled.

addEmail.effect: From resetDone: closes the sheet and the pad and opens recovery-email-add. The new PIN works now, so the email PIN check passes.

notes: ADR 0283 rule 10: the secret is always the Bipe PIN of pinLength numbers, never only 'senha', because people also have a phone code and email passwords.

Callers and their reason: recovery-email-add send (bipe_pin_reason_email_set), the email remove (bipe_pin_reason_email_remove), link-computer-approve (bipe_pin_reason_link_computer), device-verification and link-phone-approve (bipe_pin_reason_approve_device), recovery-key-save (bipe_pin_reason_recovery_key), pin-change (bipe_pin_reason_change), theft-protection addGuardian (bipe_pin_reason_guardians), account-delete enterPin (bipe_pin_reason_delete), soft-logout needsPin (bipe_pin_reason_soft_logout with the display name).
bipe_pin_blocked_body names no way out (rule 14). The forgot button under it shows the ways that exist.
The PIN goes to the server only and is never kept.
A signed-in phone ignores a recovery link (account-start openLink), so the email way runs on another phone.

The reset on this phone (ADR 0283 rule 13) is a pin_reset recovery that the server keeps with method device and lists as email in GET /v1/me/account. The waiting time and the alerts are the email path's: the other devices show recovery-alert and can cancel, the recovery email gets a notice. The phone that started it does not show recovery-alert for its own kept reset.
A phone without biometrics does not get the reset here (security.md rule 14): the passcode never passes.
